statement: The recomputed benchmark value converges to 42 percent under the declared numerator and denominator.
predicted_observations: Recomputing numerator/denominator with the declared method yields 42 percent within tolerance.
disconfirming_observations: The recomputed value differs from 42 percent by more than the declared tolerance.
assumptions: The declared numerator and denominator are the intended inputs.
methods: Exact recomputation of the declared division.
stop_conditions: Stop once the recomputed value and its tolerance band are recorded.
priority_rationale: Confirmatory branch: cheapest, most direct check of the primary claim before pursuing costlier alternatives.
